description: Search GateOnAI's database of 2,826 listed AI tools. Find tools by name, use case, category, pricing model, or GDPR info on the provider's page. Returns tool names, descriptions, pricing, GateOnAI scores, and direct URLs.

eu_hosted_only.description: Set to true to return only tools whose providers state EU hosting

gdpr_only.description: Set to true to return only tools whose provider pages refer to the GDPR

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 24)

pricing.description: Filter by pricing model: free, freemium, paid, or free_trial

query.description: Search term — tool name, use case, or description. Examples: 'video editing', 'code assistant', 'ChatGPT alternatives'

name: search_ai_tools

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Search AI Tools
